newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan's new Elgrand tops monthly sales target.
newsitem.headline: Nissan's new Elgrand tops monthly sales target.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Tuesday its new multi-purpose vehicle topped its monthly sales target within a week of its domestic launch.
Orders for the new model, the Caravan/Homy Elgrand, surpassed a monthly sales target of 5,000 units within a week of its launch in Japan on May 19, Nissan said in a statement.
As of May 26, the company had received orders totalling 5,615 units, it added.
The model is particularly popular with customers in their 30's and 40's, Nissan said.
